groups.note: Supreme Court justices and the Chancery Court judge are the people in office this January, from official Wyoming Judicial Branch dates and official retention results (shared with other counties). Official 2026 Niobrara clerk retentions for Justice Bridget Hill (YES 614 / NO 164), Justice Robert C. Jarosh (YES 605 / NO 165), and Chancery Judge Burningham (YES 616 / NO 151) are those statewide retentions. Local rows are 8th Judicial District judges (Converse, Goshen, Niobrara, and Platte). Full names and term dates follow official Wyoming Judicial Branch 8th JD pages and the official March 2026 roster already used in the Goshen and Platte histories. Official Niobrara named retentions are cited (2016 Patrick W. Korell YES 883 / NO 259; 2018 F. Scott Peasley YES 816 / NO 176 and Randal R. Arp YES 797 / NO 191; 2022 Clark C. Allan YES 796 / NO 159; 2024 Edward A. Buchanan YES 856 / NO 237, F. Scott Peasley YES 838 / NO 222, Nathaniel Scott Hibben YES 834 / NO 212; 2026 Clark C. Allan YES 648 / NO 140 and Jacqueline K. Brown YES 609 / NO 146). Official magistrate Dennis C. Meier retentions appear on official Niobrara canvasses and are not encoded as a circuit judgeship.
